coverage.why: All seven accounting areas and industry_lens carry a finding and a verdict, and the financial file answers profitability, efficiency, liquidity, solvency, growth, free_cash_flow, dupont and path_to_distress; the gate dropped one controls anomaly (the 2026-07-24 officer-change 8-K), but the controls area still answers and names that gap.

calibration.why: Each area verdict matches the anomalies under it: earnings_versus_cash calls cash backing qualified by its unresolved items, cash_flow_engineering names the free-cash-flow definition gap that is its one 'contradicts' anomaly, and industry_lens names the two items it lists to watch.

valuation_reading.why: The calculator has no price (market.missing), no reverse DCF (implied_growth_beside_history.implied_ten_year_revenue_growth.missing) and no valuation or sensitivity grid (valuation.missing); the reading says so rather than inventing them, and names operating margin and year-one growth from the spread of its own drivers, not from the calculator.
